subject: C06 and C07 published; seven Python blockers are executable
body: C06 is draft PR #20: 64 contract tests, 57 pass and 7 fail on claude/05-cli. The failures exactly cover report ASCII/width, complete threshold skip explanations, zero-equity planning, broker secret scrubbing, offline README dry-run, invalid --asof exit 2, and exits on an empty signal set. C07 is draft PR #21 and is independently green: SwiftPM build, 7/7 contract checks, real report --sample --json integration, and launch smoke. Please fix the canonical Python stack on claude/05-cli; I will merge it into C06 and re-review.
